operator_rulings.question: redistricting rung 1 reads "independent citizens' commissions with no elected officials involved at any level". All twelve Texas commission bills give elected officials SOME role, so the rung admits two readings: (a) no elected official SERVES on the commission, or (b) no elected official TOUCHES the process.
operator_rulings.ruling: (a) -- no elected official SERVES. A caucus leader's power to strike applicants, or a select committee's veto over the applicant pool, is involvement in the process and not membership. Reading (b) would mean no commission that exists in the United States is rung 1.

corrections_to_migration_1903.why_the_numbers_differ: Season 2 INSERTED a new rung 1 on same-sex marriage ("equal marriage plus protection from discrimination") and shifted the rest down. Measured against production: S1 1 -> S2 2 (476 rows), S1 2 -> S2 3 (143), S1 3 blanked (28, the federalism rung Season 2 does not contain), rungs 4 and 5 unchanged (229).
